QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showTrafficIndicators
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Shows traffic indicators, including conflict radius and line guides

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showBatteryWidget
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Show battery widget and hide battery indicator in toolbar

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: minVisibleRangeInMeters
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The minimum distance in meters for which the flight path should be visible in the fly view altitude widget.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: metersBetweenLines
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The distance in meters between the lines in the fly view altitude widget.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showWinchControlMenu
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Shows the winch control menu buttons and slider

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: horizontalConflictDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The horizontal distance to nearby traffic inside which the situation is considered a conflict, and traffic indicators turn red. Twice this distance is used for proximity detection, meaning that the indicators will turn yellow.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: verticalConflictDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The vertical distance to nearby traffic inside which the situation is considered a conflict, and traffic indicators turn red. Twice this distance is used for proximity detection, meaning that the indicators will turn yellow.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: multidroneConflictDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The radius in meters for the multidrone conflict circle drawn around the landing point.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showMultidroneConflictCircle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Show a circle around the landing point with the multidrone conflict distance as radius.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rssiWarning
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Local (drone) RSSI below this value will trigger a warning

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rssiAlert
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Local (drone) RSSI below this value will trigger an alert

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: persistentConsumeWarnLimit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: A persistent consume offset above this limit will show a battery failsafe warning

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: unitUntilThreshold
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The unit to show for remaining until next threshold

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: missionToolsInsecureHttps
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Do not validate server certificate for mission tools HTTPS connection

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: hideBreachReturnPoint
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hide breach return point that is not used by PX4 (use rally points)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: editableTelemetryBar
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Allow editing individual telemetry bar values when settings are unlocked

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: factTimeoutSecs
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Telemetry values not updated within this many seconds are shown as N/A. Set to 0 to disable.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: minSeenTraffic
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minimum number of ADSB vehicles that must be seen for the traffic indicator to show green. Below this (but above 0) the indicator shows orange.
